description: 32x32 noise-driven grid of roughjs sketchy rectangles with datamosh glitch: random slice offsets, xor composites and per-cell displacement
notable: roughjs hand-drawn fills plus a slice/xor glitch pass over a looping-noise checker grid

description: Layered 32x32 noise grid of roughjs rectangles with neighbour color-mixing, accent injection and optional gradient interpolation
notable: two-pass render: base colors first, then blends each cell with its four neighbours

description: Three stacked semi-transparent layers of a looping-noise checker grid drawn as roughjs rectangles with per-layer jitter offsets
notable: each successive layer is more transparent and offset for a drifting registration effect

description: Looping-noise checker grid of roughjs rectangles repositioned by a chosen layout: vertical, diagonal, radial or spiral warp
notable: same base grid remapped through four position functions selected at random per run

description: Random-walk trails claim grid cells rendered as solid/chequered/fives motifs, then unclaimed cells fill with hatching and nodes shift
notable: three-phase run: stepping trails, then filling empty space with hatch lines, then shifting nodes

description: Greedy subdivision of a small grid into rectangular regions, each clip-filled with animated sliding black-and-white stripes by orientation
notable: stripe direction picked per region from its aspect ratio; stripes slide with playhead

description: Quarter-circle Wang-style tiles grow into areas via edge-matching random walk on a 3x3 grid, filled from found palettes
notable: cell types constrained by an edge-mirror table so arcs stay continuous across shared edges

description: Arc Wang tiles on a 4x3 grid grown as areas, then a reduction pass recolors isolated cells to their dominant edge-aware neighbour
notable: edge-aware reduction only counts a neighbour's color if its shared edge is closed

description: Arc Wang tiles on a 3x3 grid with a color-reduction pass, colors picked from found palettes filtered for mutual WCAG contrast
notable: background and inks chosen by luminance and pairwise contrast thresholds; regenerates every 60 frames

description: Arc Wang tiles with color reduction, rounded corners on open ends and bg-colored corner notches carving smooth quilt-like shapes
notable: corner rounding derived from open/closed edges of neighbours; blank cells drop out to background

description: Precomputed rounded arc-tile shapes cross-fade via directional slide transitions; changed cells slide in/out as unioned fills, seamless loop
notable: abutting cells merged into one path per fill to avoid antialiased seams; tweakpane controls shape count and transition

description: Full Wang-tile set (right triangles plus quarter-arc corners) grown into edge-matched areas on a 3x3 grid from found palettes
notable: widest tile vocabulary of the series: nine cell types combining flat, triangular and arc edges

description: Right-triangle and square Wang tiles grown into edge-matched areas on a 3x3 grid, each area one found-palette color
notable: triangle-only tile set; areas grow by matching filled edges between neighbours

description: Same triangle Wang-tile area filler animated as a white-on-black progressive reveal cell by cell with debug indices and grid overlay
notable: debug-view aesthetic: exposes the generation order with numbered cells and magenta grid lines

description: Triangle Wang-tile areas revealed area by area along the playhead, colored from found palettes with a debug grid and indices
notable: reveals whole areas at a time rather than single cells, showing the region structure emerging

description: Only the four quarter-arc Wang tiles grown into edge-matched areas on a 3x3 grid, each area a found-palette color
notable: pared-back arc-only variant; areas can start from any arc type rather than a full square

description: 50k points in a triangle repeatedly k-means clustered, least-dense cluster hulled and removed, hulls tinted by an oklch hue ramp
notable: iterative peel: each pass carves off the sparsest cluster as a convex-hull patch until points run out

description: Triangle grid where each cell is fractured by k-means/convex-hull into palette-colored patches, then Atkinson-dithered
notable: tiles a triangular lattice then shatters each triangle into hull patches; downscaled Atkinson dither for a grainy print look

description: A single square eased around the canvas perimeter using @daeinc/pd-timeline sequential ranges (left-right, top-bottom, etc.)
notable: demo of the pd-timeline range API sequencing four directional moves into one loop

description: Plotter artwork of 30 concentric circles plus 12 crosshatch diameters, exported to optimized SVG at A4 physical dimensions
notable: penplot export scaffold: builds paths in cm and renders an optimized plotter SVG

description: One-point-perspective corridor: radial lines to a central vanishing point with concentric quad panels colored from a rampensau ramp
notable: nested inner/outer rings of angled vertices form trapezoidal wall panels around the vanishing point

description: Physarum slime-mold simulation: 16k agents sense trail brightness ahead/left/right, steer and wrap, leaving white paths on fading black
notable: reads back canvas pixels each frame as the pheromone field driving agent turning

description: Physarum slime-mold simulation seeded on two rings so networks grow outward from circular emitters into white trail structures
notable: agents spawned on two offset circles rather than uniformly, giving two competing colonies

description: Physarum agents spawned on sphere-packed circles; trails accumulate in an offscreen pheromone buffer while colored dots render on-screen, mouse-seedable, optional dither
notable: separates the sensed trail field (offscreen) from the colored display; drag to inject agents, 'd' toggles Atkinson dither
